2608.14329.title: A Four-Axis Trustworthiness Benchmark for LLM-as-Judge in Principle-Based Regulation
2608.14329.paper_summary: Principle-based regulation, with evaluative standards such as "fair, clear, and not misleading" or "deliver good outcomes", cannot be reduced to binary predicates, and LLM-as-judge is increasingly used as the substitute. Our position is that any such judge must be evaluated on four axes: accuracy, paraphrase robustness, adversarial robustness, and calibration. We release Principle-Bench, 168 cryptoasset financial-promotion scenarios mapped to two UK FCA principles, with paraphrase, adversarial keyword-stuffing, and boundary perturbations authored under a pre-registered rubric; the first benchmark covering all four axes for principle-based regulation. We also introduce Ceca (Calibrated Exemplar-Cluster Assessment): a calibrated, auditable assessor that emits exact per-exemplar counterfactual attributions. Across keyword counting, three sentence-transformer embedders, an open-weight LLM-judge, and a calibrated cascade, no method dominates all four axes. A 120B LLM-judge, strongest on benign inputs, loses 47 accuracy points (0.74 to 0.27) on keyword-stuffed Consumer Duty inputs: "compliance theatre." A second judge from a different model family agrees only at Cohen's kappa = 0.16 on that split, localising the failure to the model rather than the corpus. Any deployment-grade LLM-judge for principle-based regulation must report per-principle adversarial deception and post-hoc calibration alongside aggregate accuracy.
2608.14329.paper_summary_zh: 原則基礎的監管，具有「公平、清晰且不具誤導性」或「提供良好結果」等評估標準，無法簡化為二元判斷，而 LLM 作為裁判的使用越來越普遍。我們的立場是，任何這樣的裁判必須在四個軸向上進行評估：準確性、改述穩健性、對抗穩健性和校準。我們發布了 Principle-Bench，這是一個映射到兩個英國 FCA 原則的 168 個加密資產金融促銷場景，包含在預註冊標準下撰寫的改述、對抗關鍵詞堆疊和邊界擾動；這是首個涵蓋原則基礎監管四個軸向的基準。我們還介紹了 Ceca（校準示例集群評估）：一個可校準的、可審計的評估者，能夠發出每個示例的精確反事實歸因。在關鍵詞計數、三個句子轉換嵌入器、一個開放權重的 LLM 裁判和一個校準級聯中，沒有任何方法在所有四個軸向上佔據主導地位。一個 120B 的 LLM 裁判，在良性輸入上最強，但在關鍵詞堆疊的消費者責任輸入上損失了 47 個準確性點（從 0.74 降至 0.27）：「合規劇場。」來自不同模型家族的第二個裁判在該分割上僅同意 Cohen 的 kappa = 0.16，將失敗定位於模型而非語料庫。任何用於原則基礎監管的部署級 LLM 裁判必須報告每個原則的對抗性欺騙和事後校準，以及總體準確性。
2608.14329.author: Dipankar Sarkar et.al.
